# answer-now
English | 中文
A DeepSeek Harness plugin that pushes the agent to **deliver its answer as soon as it has one**, ins
tead of burning your time on extra queries.
## What it does
1. **Injects instructions into the system prompt** — stop querying the moment you can answer, never

repeat a query, prefer one decisive query over several narrow ones, no filler tool calls.
2. **Count
s tool calls per agent per turn** — and when the count crosses a threshold, injects an escalating re
minder into the agent's inbox ("answer now instead of querying further" → "stop calling tools and pr

oduce your final answer").
3. **Resets on new user messages**, so each of your turns starts fresh.
It is advisory-only: it never blocks or rejects a tool call, so it can't break a legitimate workflow

## Installing on another machine (中文说明见 README.zh.md)
Each machine has its own DSH profile, so the plugin isn't shared automatically. On the other compute
r, just run one of the install commands above (use `dsh profile list` to find the profile name if it
isn't `desktop`), then restart `dsh web` (or reload the page).
> **Local `link:` installs:** if you installed from a local folder with a `link:` entry (development
copy), the plugin is bound to that folder on disk — keep the folder around or the link breaks. Publ
ished npm/GitHub installs are self-contained and don't have this dependency.
